scope: Literal one-H finite collective-field candidate. Two actual divergence-free spatial mode functions on R3, one shared full64-state CAR supplier, all core N=0/1/2 frame-Gauss sectors. No prior body/D/G law collage and no bulk photon claim.
side_effects: Pure constructors; only old import is frame_gauss from rich_frame_gauss_20261014_model.py. No old oscillator, carrier, D, capture, current or producer imported.
ordering: field=(a_z grid outer,a_y grid inner), physical frame sector, supplier full64=(one flavour0 site,one flavour1 site). Dimension grid^2 * (1,2,1)[N] *64. Field spacing dx=2wall/(grid+1), omitted endpoints are Dirichlet. Stored vectors use Euclidean discrete norm; continuum quadrature factor absorbed in amplitudes.
field_topology: a_z,a_y real noncompact coordinates; walls are declared finite preparation/regulator, not large-gauge quotient. Continuum A is a_z(e_z cross x)exp(-r^2/(2ell^2))+a_y(e_y cross x)exp(-r^2/(2ell^2)). Same A is used in finite-width supplier hopping and continuum core current. Localized collective profiles are not two plane-wave momentum eigenstates.
field_metric: mass=epsilon*pi^(3/2)*ell^5; H_E=-Delta_a/(2mass). Electric field E_T=-sum P_alpha u_alpha/mass. curl Gram is computed from actual3D geometry, NOT used as magnetic energy. P is centered first derivative; H_E is second-difference Laplacian, not the square of that finite P. Their finite-grid canonical commutator has discretization/boundary error; no exact continuum CCR asserted at finite grid.
charge_meanings: Supplier flavours carry +1 each; fixed ions each -1/4 neutralize total+2. Core has -N, N2 is charge-2, not antiparticle. rho(k) includes same Gaussian supplier, ions and core as H_L. E_L(k)=-ik rho/(epsilon k^2). No source-energy or ionic-reference repinning.

current_api.J: list2 CSR Hermitian total mode currents -partial H/partial a; supplier and core both included
current_api.Jsupplier: Peierls derivative with all64 supplier configurations and virtual transitions
current_api.Jcore: Actual integrated rotating Gaussian current, C*(ic*S_component-C*(ic+ir)*A_component), in the exactly conserved l0 sector
current_api.K: 2x2 CSR contact partial^2 H/partial a_alpha partial a_beta, including charged kinetic contact
current_api.shifted: shifted((delta0,delta1)) rebuilds matter and body from actual shifted continuum A for derivative probes
current_api.current_fourier: current_fourier(k3) returns three complex CSR spatial currents from Gaussian-smeared bond flows plus Gaussian rotating core; k3 in inverse length. S matrices are NOT substituted for this current.
current_api.density_fourier: density_fourier(k3) returns same-law total density, with static ions and core. Fourier convention exp(-ik.x). Continuity i[H,rho]+ik.j=0.
current_api.longitudinal: HL diagonal from full finite-width pair kernel, self terms and cross-charge terms. charge_data exposes positions,widths,charges,kernel. No independent longitudinal oscillator sector.
current_api.source_to: neutral.source_to(charged,i) or odd.source_to(pair,i), i=0,1: actual frame-coordinate dressed CAR creator between adjacent sectors, identity on SAME field and supplier coordinates
current_api.S: three physical LEFT frame-coordinate differential generators after Gauss sewing; in l0 these equal core physical angular generator. Fixed cube/two-mode environment breaks full spatial rotational symmetry, so [H,S] is physical torque, not conserved total J.
current_api.spectrum: spectrum(H,count): sparse eigsh + QR/Rayleigh-Ritz with residual and orthonormality. This is a selected low spectral window, not proof every degenerate partner is present. actual2 odd final columns have unmatched energies; do not infer complete group residues there. Ground doublet and its chosen physical Sz polarization are explicit. Full G/D/current resolvents and event evolution use all states, never this window. Frozen-versus-full lowest-gap comparisons do not automatically identify the same bright field branch.
current_api.full_resolvent: full_resolvent(H,complex_energy,columns) returns full-space solutions of (energy-H)x=columns plus actual residual norms

source_response: G_ij(z)=<d_i^dag g0 | (E0+z-H1)^-1 | d_j^dag g0>. E0 is the SAME neutral supplier/field ground in the finite regulator. No scalar normalization or artificial mass receiver. Current threepoint uses R(E0+z+.17) J_alpha R(E0+z). Pair source uses E1 and actual H2; pair is not positron.
complete_odd_response: actual2/grid/box also evaluate the charged-state fermionic retarded response with BOTH H2 addition and H0 removal, anchored at the same E1, and verify addition_gram+transpose(removal_gram)=I2. Formula Gadd=<d_i R(E1+z,H2) d_jdag>; Gremove=<d_jdag (z+H0-E1)^-1 d_i>. Separate vacuum addition, charged retarded G and charged stationary D are named different response states of ONE law, not silently equated.
field_response: Retarded coordinate tensor D_ab(z)=<g|delta A_a(z-(H-Eg))^-1 delta A_b|g>-<g|delta A_b(z+(H-Eg))^-1 delta A_a|g>, evaluated via two full resolvents on the same charged stationary state. This is not imported Maxwell D. Electric/current Grams are separate observables.
event: Prepare normalized maximal physical Sx member in actual two-column neutral-to-charged source image. Compare exp(i eta A0) preparation to its own source baseline under the SAME H. Also normalize (P0+iP1) source, then apply exp(-i nu J0) and evolve. All supplier/field states remain unresolved for inclusive actual Sz +/- and a1 positive/negative commuting projectors (four probabilities summing1). Source return is norm-squared projection onto the original orthonormal source image, not automatically a spin measurement or scattering cross section.
event_locality_boundary: The output label local_field_unitary means a unitary on one collective field coordinate. Its actual spatial profile extends over the Gaussian mode. No spatially local signal, propagation speed, strict far detector or relativistic causality is claimed.
controls: induction=False removes every supplier hopping while preserving all64 states, physical charges, ions and Coulomb law. metric=False sets common inverse inertia to0, preserving frame halfspin and remaining core contact but eliminating frame-spin current. Every control evolves its own same-seed baseline. Neutral induction-off has no core contact or magnetic term; exact box field product is used with its actual lowest matter configuration.
assumptions: CAR/flavours/colour/centre bundle, Gaussian rigid core, l0 source preparation, fixed ionic cubic supplier, hopping/U, positive angular metric, primitive electric law, two-mode Galerkin geometry and finite amplitude box. l>0 sectors are excluded only by exact L^2 conservation for this spherical-density law and chosen source, not claimed absent from a free body. Higher represented field/matter states are retained; continuum field-box/grid convergence is separate.
